import bpy, math
from mathutils import Vector

bpy.ops.wm.read_factory_settings(use_empty=True)

def mat(name, color, metallic=0, roughness=.45):
    m = bpy.data.materials.new(name)
    m.diffuse_color = (*color, 1)
    m.use_nodes = True
    p = m.node_tree.nodes.get('Principled BSDF')
    p.inputs['Base Color'].default_value = (*color, 1)
    p.inputs['Metallic'].default_value = metallic
    p.inputs['Roughness'].default_value = roughness
    return m

wood = mat('Honey oak', (.43,.20,.065))
steel = mat('Forest green powder coat', (.035,.095,.064), .65)
bolt = mat('Stainless fasteners', (.48,.51,.52), .85)
ground = mat('Warm paving', (.28,.29,.26))

def box(name, loc, size, material, bevel=.02):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(size=1, location=loc)
    o = bpy.context.object
    o.name = name
    o.dimensions = size
    bpy.ops.object.transform_apply(location=False, rotation=False, scale=True)
    o.data.materials.append(material)
    if bevel:
        b = o.modifiers.new('Soft edges', 'BEVEL'); b.width=bevel; b.segments=3
        o.modifiers.new('Weighted normals', 'WEIGHTED_NORMAL')
    return o

def bar(name, a, b, width, depth, material):
    a,b = Vector(a),Vector(b)
    o = box(name, (a+b)/2, (width,depth,(b-a).length),material,.012)
    o.rotation_euler = (b-a).to_track_quat('Z','Y').to_euler()
    return o

def screw(loc, axis):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_uv_sphere_add(segments=12, ring_count=6, radius=1, location=loc)
    o=bpy.context.object; o.name='Slat carriage bolt'; o.scale=(.013,.013,.006)
    o.rotation_euler=Vector(axis).to_track_quat('Z','Y').to_euler()
    o.data.materials.append(bolt)

# Two-person seat, five independent timber slats.
for i in range(5):
    y=-.255+i*.124
    box('Seat slat %02d'%i,(0,y,.505),(1.65,.108,.055),wood,.012)
    for x in (-.65,.65): screw((x,y,.535),(0,0,1))

# Lean the back uprights and slats together.
angle=math.radians(11)
for i in range(4):
    z=.70+i*.125
    y=.28+(z-.55)*math.tan(angle)
    o=box('Backrest slat %02d'%i,(0,y,z),(1.65,.045,.105),wood,.012)
    o.rotation_euler.x=-angle
    for x in (-.65,.65): screw((x,y-.026,z),(0,-math.cos(angle),math.sin(angle)))

for x in (-.65,.65):
    box('Seat support rail',(x,0,.447),(.065,.66,.065),steel,.012)
    bar('Front splayed leg',(x,-.32,.06),(x,-.23,.45),.065,.065,steel)
    bar('Rear splayed leg',(x,.35,.06),(x,.24,.45),.065,.065,steel)
    bar('Back upright',(x,.245,.42),(x,.39,1.145),.055,.055,steel)
    bar('Arm front support',(x,-.21,.45),(x,-.21,.755),.045,.045,steel)
    box('Timber arm cap',(x,.015,.78),(.115,.60,.05),wood,.02)
    for y in (-.32,.35):
        box('Anchor foot',(x,y,.035),(.16,.13,.045),steel,.015)
bar('Lower cross brace',(-.65,.18,.255),(.65,.18,.255),.045,.045,steel)
box('Ground',(0,0,-.065),(200,200,.1),ground,.0)

world.node_tree.nodes['Background'].inputs[1].default_value=.35

    bpy.ops.object.light_add(type='AREA', location=loc)
    o=bpy.context.object; o.name=name; o.data.energy=power; o.data.shape='DISK'; o.data.size=size
    o.rotation_euler=(Vector((0,0,.5))-o.location).to_track_quat('-Z','Y').to_euler()

import bpy, math
from mathutils import Vector
bpy.ops.wm.read_factory_settings(use_empty=True)

def material(name, color, roughness=.45, metal=0):
    m=bpy.data.materials.new(name); m.diffuse_color=(*color,1); m.use_nodes=True
    p=m.node_tree.nodes.get('Principled BSDF'); p.inputs['Base Color'].default_value=(*color,1)
    p.inputs['Roughness'].default_value=roughness; p.inputs['Metallic'].default_value=metal
    return m

wood_light=material('Walnut alternate boards',(.29,.135,.059))
fabric=material('Oatmeal upholstery',(.67,.61,.49),.9)

def box(name,loc,size,mat,bevel=.015):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(size=1,location=loc)
    o=bpy.context.object; o.name=name; o.dimensions=size
    bpy.ops.object.transform_apply(location=False,rotation=False,scale=True)
    o.data.materials.append(mat)
    if bevel:
        m=o.modifiers.new('Rounded joinery','BEVEL'); m.width=bevel; m.segments=3
        o.modifiers.new('Weighted normals','WEIGHTED_NORMAL')
    return o

def beam(name,a,b,width,depth,mat):
    a,b=Vector(a),Vector(b)
    o=box(name,(a+b)/2,(width,depth,(b-a).length),mat,.009)
    o.rotation_euler=(b-a).to_track_quat('Z','Y').to_euler(); return o

# A 1.8 m table, with a five-board top and supporting aprons.
for i in range(5):
    box('Tabletop plank %d'%i,(0,-.44+(i+.5)*.176,.765),(1.8,.174,.065),wood if i%2==0 else wood_light,.008)
for x in (-.76,.76):
    for y in (-.32,.32):
        beam('Table leg',(x*1.06,y*1.08,.045),(x,y,.735),.075,.075,wood)
for y in (-.32,.32): box('Long table apron',(0,y,.665),(1.57,.035,.13),wood,.007)
for x in (-.76,.76): box('End table apron',(x,0,.665),(.035,.65,.13),wood,.007)

# Chair local front is -Y; rotate each pair to face the tabletop.
def chair(index,center,angle):
    c,s=math.cos(angle),math.sin(angle)
    def point(p):
        x,y,z=p; return (center[0]+c*x-s*y,center[1]+s*x+c*y,z)
    def part(name,loc,size,mat,bevel=.012):
        o=box('Chair %d / '%index+name,point(loc),size,mat,bevel); o.rotation_euler.z=angle; return o
    def rail(name,a,b,w=.043,d=.043):
        return beam('Chair %d / '%index+name,point(a),point(b),w,d,wood)
    part('Seat frame',(0,0,.443),(.46,.46,.065),wood)
    part('Upholstered seat',(0,-.01,.487),(.435,.43,.048),fabric,.02)
    for x in (-.18,.18):
        rail('Front leg',(x*1.13,-.205,.025),(x,-.175,.43),.048,.048)
        rail('Rear leg and back post',(x*1.10,.215,.025),(x,.19,.48),.045,.045)
        rail('Back upright',(x,.19,.43),(x,.265,.96),.045,.045)
        rail('Side stretcher',(x,-.19,.21),(x,.205,.21),.027,.027)
    rail('Front stretcher',(-.19,-.19,.23),(.19,-.19,.23),.026,.026)
    for z in (.66,.79,.92):
        y=.19+(z-.43)*(.075/.53)
        o=part('Backrest slat',(0,y,z),(.36,.034,.085),wood,.009)
        o.rotation_euler=( -math.atan(.075/.53),0,angle)

for i,(x,y,a) in enumerate([(-.49,-.85,math.pi),(.49,-.85,math.pi),(-.49,.85,0),(.49,.85,0)],1):
    chair(i,(x,y),a)

world.node_tree.nodes['Background'].inputs[0].default_value=(.7,.76,.82,1)
world.node_tree.nodes['Background'].inputs[1].default_value=.3

cam.rotation_euler=(Vector((0,0,.48))-cam.location).to_track_quat('-Z','Y').to_euler()
cam.data.type='ORTHO'; cam.data.ortho_scale=3.75

scene.render.resolution_x=1400; scene.render.resolution_y=1100; scene.render.resolution_percentage=100

def cylinder(name,loc,radius,depth,ma,axis=(0,0,1),vertices=48):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(vertices=vertices,radius=radius,depth=depth,location=loc)
    o=bpy.context.object; o.name=name; o.rotation_euler=Vector(axis).to_track_quat('Z','Y').to_euler(); o.data.materials.append(ma)
    b=o.modifiers.new('Machined edges','BEVEL'); b.width=.008; b.segments=2
    o.modifiers.new('Weighted normals','WEIGHTED_NORMAL'); return o

def rod(name,a,b,r,ma):
    a,b=Vector(a),Vector(b); return cylinder(name,(a+b)/2,r,(b-a).length,ma,b-a,24)

def disc(name,x,y,z,r,d,ma):

        o.modifiers.new('Weighted normals','WEIGHTED_NORMAL')
    return o

def disc(name,x,y,z,r,depth,ma):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(vertices=64,radius=r,depth=depth,location=(x,y,z),rotation=(math.pi/2,0,0))
    o=bpy.context.object; o.name=name; o.data.materials.append(ma)
    b=o.modifiers.new('Fine edge bevel','BEVEL'); b.width=.003; b.segments=2
    o.modifiers.new('Weighted normals','WEIGHTED_NORMAL'); return o

def ring(name,z,r,tube,y,ma):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_torus_add(major_segments=64,minor_segments=12,location=(0,y,z),rotation=(math.pi/2,0,0),major_radius=r,minor_radius=tube)
    o=bpy.context.object; o.name=name; o.data.materials.append(ma)
    for p in o.data.polygons: p.use_smooth=True

# Drivers are lathed radial profiles, with visible cone slope, surrounds and domes.
def driver(name,z,r):
    disc(name+' mounting flange',0,-.288,z,r,.033,black)
    ring(name+' trim',z,r*.945,r*.027,-.311,metal)
    # Cone remains in front of the baffle, recessed behind its projecting surround.
    profile=[(r*.12,-.303),(r*.23,-.307),(r*.37,-.319),(r*.64,-.342),(r*.77,-.358)]
    seg=64; verts=[]
    for radius,y in profile:
        for i in range(seg):
            a=2*math.pi*i/seg; verts.append((radius*math.cos(a),y,z+radius*math.sin(a)))
    faces=[]
    for j in range(len(profile)-1):
        for i in range(seg):
            ni=(i+1)%seg; faces.append((j*seg+i,j*seg+ni,(j+1)*seg+ni,(j+1)*seg+i))
    mesh=bpy.data.meshes.new(name+' cone mesh'); mesh.from_pydata(verts,[],faces); mesh.update()
    o=bpy.data.objects.new(name+' cone',mesh); bpy.context.collection.objects.link(o); o.data.materials.append(cone)
    for p in mesh.polygons:p.use_smooth=True
    ring(name+' rolled surround',z,r*.81,r*.074,-.347,rubber)
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_uv_sphere_add(segments=40,ring_count=20,radius=1,location=(0,-.316,z))
    o=bpy.context.object; o.name=name+' dust dome'; o.scale=(r*.285,r*.17,r*.285); o.data.materials.append(rubber)
    for p in o.data.polygons:p.use_smooth=True
    for k in range(4):
        a=math.pi/4+k*math.pi/2; x=r*.89*math.cos(a); zz=z+r*.89*math.sin(a)
        disc(name+' mounting screw',x,-.327,zz,r*.037,.009,metal)
        box(name+' screw slot',(x,-.333,zz),(r*.042,.003,r*.009),black,.0005)
